title: Approximate reference estimates for five unresolved GrowFit foods
basis: Values are approximate per 100 g edible portion unless otherwise stated. Null means no sufficiently defensible estimate was selected.

activation.reason: Estimates and proxy foods are not equivalent to direct, analytically verified food-composition records.

foods.name: گوشت گوسفندی لخم (پخته)
foods.proxy: Roasted lamb leg, lean and fat, UK composition proxy; not a direct match for GrowFit's 250 kcal / 26 g protein / 16 g fat record.
foods.note: Use only as a rough orientation. Lamb cut, fat trimming, cooking method and animal origin can materially change values.

foods.name: دوغ
foods.proxy: Sodium value is a secondary-table lead only; the underlying Iranian food-table record/code was not identified.
foods.note: 421 mg/100 g is not a verified universal Doogh value. Brand, dilution and added salt cause substantial variation; all other micronutrients remain null.

foods.name: نان سنگک
foods.proxy: Iranian bread composition table for fiber; regional bread survey for sodium and potassium.
foods.note: Sodium is highly variable (regional survey mean 663 mg/100 g, SD 338); do not treat as a fixed recipe value.

foods.name: نان بربری
foods.proxy: Iranian bread composition table for fiber; regional bread survey for sodium and potassium.
foods.note: Sodium is highly variable (regional survey mean 550 mg/100 g, SD 588); sesame topping and bakery recipe can change composition.

foods.name: نان لواش
foods.proxy: Iranian bread composition table for fiber; regional bread survey for sodium and potassium.
foods.note: Sodium is highly variable (regional survey mean 608 mg/100 g, SD 441); thickness, recipe and bakery salt vary.

policy: These are rough reference estimates, not approved nutrient evidence. Missing values are intentionally null. Do not copy this file into micronutrientsPer100g or meal totals without a separate review and approval.
